units.locator: Article 22. Conclusion and entry into force of a service contract
units.text: Article 22. Conclusion and entry into force of a service contract
units.label: Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Conclusion and entry into force of a service contract
units.text: 1. A service contract is concluded on the basis of a state body’s act appointing the person to a civil service position.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Conclusion and entry into force of a service contract
units.text: 2. Upon conclusion of a service contract, the employer’s representative must familiarize the civil servant, against a signed acknowledgement, with the state body’s service rules and the civil service legislation applicable to the performance of the civil servant’s official duties.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Conclusion and entry into force of a service contract
units.text: 3. A service contract enters into force on the date it is signed by the parties, unless otherwise provided by civil service legislation or the service contract.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Conclusion and entry into force of a service contract
units.text: 4. A civil servant must begin performing official duties on the date specified in the service contract.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. Conclusion and entry into force of a service contract
units.text: 5. If a civil servant fails, without valid reasons, to begin performing official duties within one week of the prescribed date, the service contract is deemed not to have been concluded and the state body’s act of appointment is deemed ineffective.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 23. Documents presented upon conclusion of a service contract
units.text: Article 23. Documents presented upon conclusion of a service contract
units.label: Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Documents presented upon conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 1. A citizen entering the civil service shall present the following to the employer’s representative:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Documents presented upon conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 1) an application requesting admission to the civil service and appointment to a civil service position;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Documents presented upon conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 2) the questionnaire provided for by Article 20.3 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Documents presented upon conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 3) a passport;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Documents presented upon conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 4) an employment record book and/or employment activity information prepared in accordance with the procedure established by labour legislation, except where professional service (employment) activity is undertaken for the first time; 5) a document confirming registration in the individual (personalized) record-keeping system, except where service (employment) activity is undertaken for the first time;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Documents presented upon conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 6) a certificate of registration of the individual with the tax authority at their place of residence in the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Documents presented upon conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 7) military registration documents, for citizens in the reserve and persons liable to conscription;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Documents presented upon conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 8) a document on education and qualifications;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Documents presented upon conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 9) information on income, property and property-related obligations.
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Documents presented upon conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 10) the information provided for by Article 16.2 of this Law;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Documents presented upon conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 11) a medical organization's opinion confirming the absence of an illness preventing entry into or performance of the civil service.
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Documents presented upon conclusion of a service contract
units.text: 2. In individual cases, taking account of the conditions of civil service established by federal civil service legislation, a requirement to present other documents may be provided for upon conclusion of a service contract.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service
units.text: Article 24. Probation in the civil service
units.label: Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 1. When a service contract is concluded with a citizen entering the civil service for the first time, that contract and the state body's appointment act provide for a probationary period of one month to one year to assess the civil servant's suitability for the position held, unless otherwise provided by this Article.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 2. Probation may be established:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 1) upon appointment to a civil service position of a citizen who has previously performed state service of the Russian Federation — for one to six months; 2) upon appointment of a civil servant to a civil service position by transfer from another state body — for one to six months.
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 3. No probation is established for:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 1) citizens who obtained secondary vocational education through a programme for training middle-level specialists or higher education under a targeted education agreement undertaking subsequent civil service, and who enter the civil service for the first time;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 2) civil servants appointed to civil service positions by transfer in connection with the liquidation or reorganization of a state body, the reduction of civil service positions or the abolition of a state body;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 3) other citizens and civil servants for whom the legislation of the Russian Federation provides guarantees of retention of their job (position).
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 4. During probation, the provisions of federal laws, this Law and other regulatory legal acts on the civil service apply to the civil servant.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 5. Upon expiry of the prescribed probationary period, if the civil servant does not hold the class rank corresponding to the civil service position held, a class rank is conferred in accordance with Article 8 of this Law.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 6. Periods of a civil servant's temporary incapacity for work and other periods when they did not actually perform official duties are excluded from the probationary period.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 7. If probation is unsuccessful, the employer's representative may terminate the service contract before the probationary period expires, giving the civil servant written notice at least three days in advance and stating the reasons for finding that the civil servant failed probation.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 8. A civil servant may challenge the employer’s representative’s decision in court.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 9. If the probationary period expires and the civil servant continues to hold the civil service position, they are deemed to have passed probation.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Probation in the civil service
units.text: 10. Before the expiry of probation, the service contract may be terminated on the civil servant’s initiative; the civil servant must give the employer’s representative written notice at least three days in advance.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.label: Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 1. In the cases established by the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’ and this Law, a civil servant’s transfer to another civil service position in the same state body, including in another locality, or to another civil service position in another state body is permitted: 1) on the employer’s representative’s initiative with the civil servant’s written consent, unless otherwise provided by this Law;
units.label: Part 1 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 2) on the civil servant's initiative, by decision of the employer's representative.
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 2. Unless otherwise provided by the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’ and this Law, a civil servant’s transfer to another civil service position in another state body on the civil servant’s initiative is carried out by agreement between the employer’s representative of the state body in which the civil servant holds a position and the employer’s representative of the receiving state body, and on the basis of the civil servant’s written application submitted at least two weeks before the transfer to the employer’s representative of the state body in which the civil servant holds a position.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 3. By agreement between the employer's representative of the state body with which the service contract has been concluded and the employer's representative of the state body with which a contract is planned, and with the civil servant's consent, the civil servant may be released from the current position and transferred to another position in the other state body before the date specified in the civil servant's written application.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 4. When a service contract is terminated because of transfer to another civil service position in another state body, the civil servant's personnel file is transferred in the prescribed manner to the receiving state body.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 5. Transfer to another civil service position in the same state body takes place:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 1) on the basis of a competition;
units.label: Point 1 Part 5 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 2) upon appointment without a competition in the cases provided for by points 1, 3 and 5 of part 2 and parts 3 and 4 of Article 18 of this Law;
units.label: Point 2 Part 5 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 3) because the civil servant is unable, for health reasons confirmed by a medical opinion, to perform the duties of the position held;
units.label: Point 3 Part 5 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 4) because a civil servant who previously held the position is reinstated by court decision;
units.label: Point 4 Part 5 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 5) by decision of the employer’s representative, because the civil servant’s clearance for access to state secrets necessary for performing official duties has been terminated, or the civil servant has been refused such clearance, on the ground specified in paragraph four of part one of Article 22 of the Law of the Russian Federation ‘On State Secrets’, relating to the permanent residence abroad of their close relatives specified in Article 21 of the Law of the Russian Federation of 21 July 1993 No. 5485-I ‘On State Secrets’ and/or those persons’ possession of citizenship (nationality) of a foreign state, a residence permit or another document confirming a citizen’s right of permanent residence in a foreign state;
units.label: Point 5 Part 5 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 6) upon reduction of the civil service position held by the civil servant in accordance with Article 28 of this Law;
units.label: Point 6 Part 5 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 7) in connection with the civil servant’s rotation in accordance with Article 60.1 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’; 8) in connection with demotion in civil service position and removal from the personnel reserve, if included in it, following appraisal in accordance with point 3 of part 16 of Article 37 of this Law;
units.label: Point 7 Part 5 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 9) because it is necessary to eliminate circumstances involving direct subordination or accountability between civil servants who are close relatives or related by affinity, in order to ensure compliance with the restriction provided for by point 5 of part 1 of Article 12 of this Law;
units.label: Point 9 Part 5 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 10) because the civil servant needs to fill another civil service position temporarily in accordance with Article 27 of this Law;
units.label: Point 10 Part 5 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 11) upon refusal of a civil service position offered through rotation in the cases provided for by parts 9 and 9.1 of Article 60.1 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’;
units.label: Point 11 Part 5 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 12) where the civil servant does not agree to continue holding a civil service position because of changes in the conditions of professional service activities entailing amendment of the service contract terms in accordance with Article 26 of this Law;
units.label: Point 12 Part 5 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 13) in connection with expiry of the established term of office of a civil servant holding a position in the ‘managers’ or ‘assistants (advisers)’ category, in the case provided for by part 4 of Article 35 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’;
units.label: Point 13 Part 5 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 14) where a civil servant holds citizenship (nationality) of a foreign state which has not been terminated for reasons beyond their control, in exceptional cases, in accordance with the procedure and subject to the conditions established by point 14 of part 5 of Article 28 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’.
units.label: Point 14 Part 5 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 6. A civil servant’s transfer to another civil service position in another state body takes place: 1) on the basis of a competition;
units.label: Part 6 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 2) upon appointment without a competition in the cases provided for by points 1, 3 and 5 of part 2 and parts 3 and 4 of Article 18 of this Law;
units.label: Point 2 Part 6 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 3) upon reduction of a civil service position or abolition of a state body in accordance with Article 28 of this Law;
units.label: Point 3 Part 6 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 4) in connection with the civil servant’s rotation in accordance with Article 60.1 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’;
units.label: Point 4 Part 6 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 5) upon refusal of a civil service position offered through rotation in the cases provided for by parts 9 and 9.1 of Article 60.1 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’.
units.label: Point 5 Part 6 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 7. Transfer to another civil service position in the cases provided for by this Article requires the civil servant to meet the qualification requirements for that other position.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 8. In the cases provided for by points 3-5, 9 and 12-14 of part 5 of this Article, transfer of a civil servant to another civil service position involving demotion is permitted only where it is impossible to transfer the civil servant to a position in the same category and group as the position currently held and with a position salary no lower than that of the position currently held.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 9. Transfer to another civil service position in the same state body under this Article is formalized by a legal act of the state body and accompanied by amendment of the service contract through a supplementary agreement.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 10. Unless otherwise provided by federal laws, where transfer under points 3-5, 8, 9 and 12-14 of part 5 of this Article is impossible because no other civil service position is available, or where the civil servant refuses a transfer under this Article, the civil servant shall be dismissed from the civil service. In these cases, the service contract is terminated, the civil servant is released from the position held and dismissed from the civil service in accordance with point 8 of part 1 of Article 33 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’, unless another ground for dismissal is expressly established by that Federal Law; by decision of the employer’s representative and with the civil servant’s consent, the civil servant is included in the personnel reserve, except in the case provided for by point 8 of part 5 of this Article.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Transfer to another civil service position or reassignment
units.text: 11. Reassignment to another structural subdivision of the same state body in the same locality is not a transfer to another civil service position and does not require the civil servant's consent if it does not change the terms of the service contract, except the term concerning the place of civil service.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 25
